text_block_list.text:
A few days after the incident in front of
the Three Goddesses statue.
An exhibition race was held at a fan event
at Tokyo Racecourse, and—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Hey.
Over there where all the trainers are swarming
together—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's a squeaky-clean rookie among 'em.
Is that the one from the rumors?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Buena-chan's childhood friend?! No way,
where, where?!
Wait wait,
did you guys contract already?! You did?!
That's soooo emotional-core!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yes, that's them!
And right now—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We're still on a provisional contract.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oops,
look at the time...!
I have to go prep for the race!
Well then, Nakayama-san, Jordan-san,
please excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
............Wait,
fr?! "Provisional"?!
What's that supposed to meaaan?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And the exhibition race is finally entering
its final stretch! 400 meters to go!
Surging up on the outside is Buena Vista!
Buena Vista with a blistering run!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
My! What an incredible finishing burst she
has...!
If she's already like this before debuting...
hehe,
she'll truly shine with a little polish!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
There were rumors that this exhibition had
quite the lineup of talent...
But Buena Vista clearly stands head and
shoulders above the rest!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Across the finish line!
First place goes to Buena Vista!!
It's Buena Vista!!
She put on a sensational show,
serving as the true star of this
exhibition!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Despite being pre-debut,
Buena Vista delivered a fantastic run that
promises great things to come!
And the stands erupt with an unreserved
standing ovation!

Surrounded by thunderous cheers—
I clench my fist tight, standing alone.

She puts it vividly on display.
Forcing me to feel the gap painfully.
Come to think of it—
back then was just the same.

Back then,
the daily grind at the training academy I
studied so hard to enter
was far more brutal and demanding than I
had ever imagined,
leaving me constantly floundering.

text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it—
I found myself standing before the academy
gates I had yearned for.
Ashamed of my own weakness,
yet my eyes couldn't help but search for
her.

Just then,
a roar of cheers erupted from the track—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
Hyaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh...! She's... in-saaaane...!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so that's who we're gonna debut
against...
This bet's lookin' worse and worse by the
second...!

...To think I had wanted to trade words of
encouragement.
Watching her from outside the academy
fence,
she had already become an untouchable star
far beyond my reach.

Leaving far behind someone like me who wasn't
even sure if I'd ever become a trainer...
she had already begun to shine as a runner
with a dazzling future.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... Big bro,
where are you...?
Don't leave Buu-chan behind...!!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... Big sis,
where are you...?
Don't leave Buu-chan behind...!!
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm right here! Come on, Buena.

text_block_list.text:
...Being able to hold her hand and lead the
way
lasted for only a fleeting moment when she
was very small.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, ahaha!! Over here, over here!!
Let's go, Big b—... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, ahaha!! Over here, over here!!
Let's go, Big s—... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm sorry! I ran too far ahead...
I need to go slower for you, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.text:
Before long, she was running faster and faster,
dashing off to horizons unknown.
An Umamusume born to run—unlike me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you...! Hehe,
I'm glad I got to see you.
You came to watch my exhibition race,
didn't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I got a very clear look at h...
Yeah. I got a very clear look at h...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's great.
...So,
does that mean we can start our real training
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Working toward the goal you mentioned for
our provisional contract—
Winning the "Discipline-Specific
Competition."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...We're gonna have to give it our absolute
all, aren't we?
After all,
an absurdly strong lineup of girls has
gathered—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Most notably Scarlet-chan,
who claimed the Oka Sho and Shuka Sho
to become a Double Tiara champion—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And Vodka-chan, who,
despite being a Tiara Umamusume, conquered
the dream of every Umamusume—
the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Going up against two legends who define an
era,
you promised to lead a pre-debut racer like
me to victory. ...Right?

And once that's accomplished—
I bowed my head to her the other day,
asking her to assess whether I'm truly worthy
of a full contract.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Assess...? Um, me? Assess you?
But—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ! ...You knew?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised.
I thought today was supposed to be your
first day—

I can tell. Because... you're an a...

text_block_list.text:
That's why you left me behind in the blink
of an eye.
...Even so, I just couldn't give up.

From the day I watched her through the fence
and ran home gritting my teeth,
I threw myself into studying without looking
back.
I studied like my life depended on it.

Because I wanted to catch up.
Because I wanted to stand beside her.
Not just because "we're childhood
friends"—

(I wanted to become someone she wo...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—You're right.
I definitely want to reach that breathtaking
view
just like the one Spe-san showed us back
then.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So, I intend to choose the trainer who's
the perfect match for that goal.
That's what I've decided.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Well then!
I'll be in your care starting tomorrow,
my provisional Trainer!
